references.text: The continuation of the verse explaining that wheat and spelt were not destroyed because they mature later
Mentions that the Jordan River overflowed its banks throughout the harvest season, which is the time of barley harvesting
Refers to the first ripe heads (אָבִיב), the same word used for the growth stage of barley
Regulations concerning the first fruits and the first ripe heads, linked to the barley harvest in Israel
Mentions the month Abib (אָבִיב), named after the mature stage of barley at this time of year
Prophetic judgment against Egypt that includes the destruction of flax, an important Egyptian product
God threatens to take back the flax He had given, showing the significance of flax as God's gift
